# Foca Studio
> Indie apps by Yating Lu and Raphael: Foca (Pomodoro focus timer with guided stretch breaks and ambient sounds), Dayfold (countdown and anniversary widgets) and Core (interval and HIIT timer). All ad-free.

## Key facts
- Foca is an ad-free Pomodoro focus timer for iPhone, Mac and Android, used by 300K+ people in 100+ countries.
- After each focus session, Foca guides a short stretch (neck, shoulders, back, hands, legs, full body) with illustrations and voice guidance.
- Foca includes ambient sounds (more with Foca Plus), Auto-Run (four rounds free; custom with Foca Plus) and focus statistics.
- In Foca, a guided stretch can be started at any time from the timer screen.
- Foca is free to download; Foca Plus is an optional monthly, yearly or one-time upgrade.
- Foca does not block apps or websites.
- Dayfold turns important dates into countdown and anniversary cards with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. Free for 4 active moments; Dayfold Pro is optional.
- Core is an interval timer for HIIT, Tabata, circuits and boxing, with saved workouts, audio cues and weekly trends. Core Pro adds full history, monthly and yearly trends and CSV export.
